title: Heart-Rate Variability Weekly Trend
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings measurements (`withings:measure`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export or Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, and Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=whoop:cycle
| timechart span=1w avg(hrv_ms) as hrv
| eventstats avg(hrv) as base
| eval below_baseline=if(hrv<base,1,0)
description: Trends your weekly average heart-rate variability, a sensitive marker of stress and recovery, so you can see how life is affecting your body over time.
value: Heart-rate variability responds to sleep, alcohol, stress, and training; a weekly trend connects lifestyle choices to how recovered you actually are.
implementation: Ingest Whoop or Apple heart-rate-variability data; schedule weekly and correlate dips with travel, alcohol, or heavy training.
visualization: Line chart of weekly heart-rate variability with a baseline band.
grandmaExplanation: It follows a body signal that shows how well you are recovering, so you can see what habits help or hurt you.
